details: Shared resource for all Wizard active skills; spent by skills and refilled by passive regeneration
notes: D3Planner metadata classes.wizard.resources = ["ap"]; maxroll names it Arcane Power

details: Arcane Power regenerates by itself at 10 per second, in and out of combat. This is the rule that differs from Fury, which is built in combat and decays.
notes: maxroll: "Passive Regeneration: 10 per second"; D3Planner apregen = 10

details: Arcane Power does not decay. D3Planner's resource model applies only regeneration; there is no decay term for the Wizard.
notes: maxroll describes regeneration and lists no decay; the absence of a decay term in D3Planner is the evidence for 0

details: No on-damage Arcane Power source is published. maxroll's Arcane Power source list contains none.
notes: undocumented - looked for an on-damage generation rule on maxroll's Wizard resource page and in D3Planner; found none (contrast Fury's 0.5 per 1% Life lost)

details: Prodigy: when you cast a Signature spell, you gain 5 Arcane Power

value: 1-2 per enemy hit; 9-12 per Signature Spell cast (The Shame of Delsere)
details: Electrocute (Surge of Power) +1, Shock Pulse (Power Affinity) +2, Spectral Blade (Siphoning Blade) +2 per enemy hit; The Shame of Delsere +9-12 once per Signature Spell cast, not per enemy hit
notes: Quoted from the rune tooltips and maxroll active-generation list; The Shame of Delsere's once per Signature cast is docs/decisions.md 2026-10-13 (the Architect from D3: d3planner's text is 'Your Signature Spells attack 50% faster and restore 9-12 Arcane Power', no 'hit'; bead diablocraft-o0nbj)
